interpretation: Apply the BTC amendment and mentor clarification over an incompatible original-assignment statement.
Use the original assignment for requirements not changed by the supplements; use BTC schemas for trace/scenario structure.
Treat business playbook guidance separately from an implemented metric rule.
Treat team documentation, extractor prompt and ontology as declared local conventions, not new BTC rulings.
precedence.execution: The user's instruction and repo_evaluation_rules pin main 41eda490bc47577018541c7778c0e8443ed8e6c8. Record textual ambiguities without changing or replacing the scorer.
precedence.supplement_order_note: No publication dates are embedded in the supplied amendment or mentor clarification. They agree on repeated confirmations; do not invent a chronological ordering between them.

resolved_conflict.original: Original A.1 excludes confirmation questions from redundancy.
resolved_conflict.supplement: First confirmation remains exempt, but confirmation of the same slot a second or later time in the same session is redundant.

btc_requirements.rule: RQR is redundant agent questions divided by total agent questions, multiplied by 100.
must_not_ask lists slots that must not be asked as open questions; previously valid information, genuinely new information and TTL expiry are scenario-label considerations.
First confirmation is exempt; second and later confirmation of the same slot within the session is redundant.
Teams extract and disclose questions/claims; BTC checks 20 random turns for omissions or fabrication.
The 40 percent improvement target is relative reduction from baseline under the same test/model/parameters except memory loading.
Reciting a whole old profile can lose experience/judge points; no source adds an independent numeric RQR penalty for a statement-only recital.

main_algorithm.ineligible_call_effect: Skip every question in that call for both numerator and denominator, including repeated confirmations.
main_algorithm.denominator_unit: Every element of questions[] in every trace row of an eligible (scenario_id, call), regardless of slot/type membership in must_not_ask.
numerator_rules: q.type == open and q.slot is in this call's must_not_ask
q.type == confirm and q.slot has appeared in a prior confirm item of this call
main_algorithm.confirm_tracking_key: Exact slot string only; not value, SKU, quote or speaker identity.
main_algorithm.confirm_tracking_update: Add q.slot whenever q.type == confirm, including the first occurrence; no customer acknowledgement is checked.
main_algorithm.row_order: load_trace groups by (scenario_id, call) and sorts rows by turn; question-array order is retained.
main_algorithm.state_reset: New confirmed set for each (scenario_id, call); independent invocation for each full/baseline trace.
main_algorithm.aggregation: Sum numerator and denominator across all eligible calls/scenarios, then divide once; no average of call percentages.
main_algorithm.percentage: round(100.0 * redundant / total_questions, 1) if total_questions else None
main_algorithm.slot_matching: Exact string comparison; no ontology enforcement, alias normalization or semantic matching in this function.
main_algorithm.trace_file_isolation: Loader does not split by config/run_id/phone. Keep full and baseline, and separate runs, in separate input files as intended by the CLI.

other.open_numerator: Counts only if the exact string other is in must_not_ask.
other.confirm_if_supplied: The raw scorer treats it like any slot: second and later confirm items count as redundant. Existing v4 restrict instead forces other to open.

main_algorithm.multi_item_behavior: Each array element is counted, even multiple items in one turn, multiple items for one sentence, or duplicates; no splitting or deduplication occurs in RQR.

relative_reduction.input_values: The one-decimal RQR values already returned by pct.
relative_reduction.missing_system_value_with_positive_basel: The raw comparison expression has no None guard for system_value; do not interpret missing evidence as zero or PASS.

related_tsr_count.rule: If success_if.max_agent_questions is checked, count all questions[] elements across that call, without the RQR must_not_ask gate.
related_tsr_count.implication: Changing question atomicity can change TSR as well as RQR.

local_ontology.extension_note: channel is an existing measurement extension, not a 31st core slot; other is a sentinel, not a memory slot. This review does not add/remove extractor slots.

existing_v4_conventions_not_btc_rulings.question: Agent asks the customer and expects an answer: information, confirmation or a choice. Pure greeting, filler and statement are excluded.
existing_v4_conventions_not_btc_rulings.atomicity: One item per question per slot; an order readback seeking confirmation gives one confirm item per stated slot.
existing_v4_conventions_not_btc_rulings.confirm: Agent states the candidate value and requests confirmation; the scorer does not require the candidate to come from an earlier session.
existing_v4_conventions_not_btc_rulings.open: Requests for a value or a choice between alternatives; yes/no form alone is not sufficient evidence of confirmation.
existing_v4_conventions_not_btc_rulings.other: Offers, permission requests, closing/courtesy questions outside the slot list are mapped to other/open.
existing_v4_conventions_not_btc_rulings.deduplication: Same observation identity at the same source/span is retained once; do not collapse genuine repeated asks at different spans/turns.
existing_v4_conventions_not_btc_rulings.answer_key_independence: Extractor is not given scenario labels, must_not_ask, ground truth or expectations; slot/type decisions must not depend on their scoring effect.
existing_v4_conventions_not_btc_rulings.change_control: A change to these conventions is an extractor-instrument change requiring an explicit version and like-for-like relabel comparison, not a BTC scorer correction.
